content: ORAVIG (miconazole) buccal tablets are designed for topical application to the gum, where they are used once daily. These tablets gradually dissolve, releasing miconazole over time. Miconazole is classified as an imidazole antifungal agent. Its chemical name is 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]-1H-imidazole, and it has the empirical formula C18H14Cl4N2O with a molecular weight of 416.13. The structural formula of miconazole is provided in Figure 1. The drug substance itself appears as a white to nearly white powder. Each ORAVIG tablet contains 50 mg of miconazole base, USP, along with the following inactive ingredients: hypromellose, USP; milk protein concentrate; corn starch, NF; lactose monohydrate, NF; sodium lauryl sulfate, NF; magnesium stearate, NF; and talc, USP.
